items.title: Flat Architecture
items.description: Single-layer design: tokens defined once in tokens.scss, used directly in components. No component-specific variables. Each component has one .scss file with reset and base styles. All styling controlled via layer-first CSS tokens.

details.concept: Single-layer design: tokens defined once in tokens.scss, used directly in component SCSS
details.no_abstraction: No component-specific CSS variables (e.g., --button-bg). Components use design tokens directly (e.g., var(--forms-background))
details.single_file_per_component: Each component has one .scss file containing reset and base styles
details.token_styling: All visual styles controlled via token overrides - no style attributes needed

items.title: Global Scaling System
items.description: Radix-inspired scaling: --scaling (0.9-1.1) uniformly scales spacing, heights, typography, and radius. --radius-factor (0-1.5) additionally controls roundness. Layer tokens still allow per-layer overrides.

items.title: Build System
items.description: npm run build compiles SCSS to CSS and bundles TypeScript. Output: dist/core.css + dist/core.js. Source organized in three layers: 1-shell, 2-layout, 3-primitives (with ui/forms/content subfolders).

build_scripts.build: npm run build - Compiles SCSS to CSS and bundles TypeScript

source_structure.core/1-shell/: App frame + structure (app-shell-sidebar, app-shell-stacked, header, main, footer, sidebar)
source_structure.core/3-primitives/forms/: Form elements (button, checkbox, input, label, radio, range, select, tabs, textarea)
source_structure.core/3-primitives/ui/: UI components (accordion, badge, nav-*, table, tag, toast, toolbar)
source_structure.core/core.scss: SCSS entry point (imports tokens + all layers + resets/animations/utilities)

items.title: Usage
items.description: Import core.css and core.js. Override CSS tokens on any container to change styles for all children. Works with any framework.

details.customize_tokens: Override CSS tokens on :root, body, or any container to cascade style changes to children
details.style_modes: Set layer tokens (--shell-*, --layout-*, --area-*, --section-*, --component-*, --forms-*) on any element to control all children

items.title: Frontend App
items.description: Svelte 5 documentation app in frontend/ folder. Imports lib web components (<nuke-tabs>, <nuke-accordion>, etc) and Phosphor Icons (<ph-house>, etc). Serves as dogfooding environment to test lib components.

items.title: 3-Layer Architecture
items.description: Three layers: 1-shell (app frame + structure), 2-layout (hierarchical page structure), 3-primitives (all building blocks). Layout has explicit hierarchy: layout > area > section. Primitives consolidate ui/forms/content.

details.core_scss: Resets, scrollbar styling, global states, animations, utilities

layers.1-shell: App frame + structure: app-shell-sidebar, app-shell-stacked, header, main, footer, sidebar
layers.3-primitives: All building blocks organized by type: ui/ (accordion, nav-*, table, toast), forms/ (button, input, tabs), content/ (headings, paragraph, code)

layout_hierarchy.2-2-area: Major regions within layout, uses --area-* tokens
layout_hierarchy.2-3-section: Content blocks within areas, uses --section-* tokens

items.title: Layer-First Token Naming
items.description: Tokens use layer-first naming: --shell-gap, --layout-padding, --component-radius, --forms-height. Layer tokens reference global scales (--space-*, --radius-*, --height-*) but can be overridden per-layer.

details.how_it_works: Layer tokens reference global scales by default, so --scaling affects everything. Override layer tokens to break from global scaling.

items.title: Block vs Island Mode
items.description: Two aesthetic modes controlled by layer tokens. Block mode (--*-gap: 1px, --*-radius: 0, --*-border: none): Japanese hairline aesthetic - body color shows through 1px gaps creating visual borders. Island mode (--*-gap: 5px+, --*-radius: 3px+, --*-border: 1px solid): floating card aesthetic - visible separation, rounded corners, explicit borders.

items.title: Forms Padding Calculation
items.description: Form elements (buttons, inputs, etc.) don't use padding tokens. Instead, padding is calculated from height and ratio: padding = forms-height × (1 - forms-ratio). --forms-ratio (0.4=airy, 0.5=balanced, 0.7=tight) controls content density within form elements.

items.title: Web Components vs Pure CSS
items.description: Most styling is pure CSS on native HTML elements. Web components (nuke-*) only add interactivity. Icons use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/webcomponents) as <ph-*> elements.

details.pure_css: Native HTML styled by CSS:

items.title: Component Usage Patterns
items.description: Web components use slots for content. Shell: <nuke-app-shell-sidebar collapsed><aside>nav</aside><main>content</main></nuke-app-shell-sidebar>. Accordion: <nuke-accordion expanded><nuke-accordion-header>Title</nuke-accordion-header><nuke-accordion-content>Body</nuke-accordion-content></nuke-accordion>. Tabs: <nuke-tabs><nuke-tab>Tab 1</nuke-tab><nuke-tab>Tab 2</nuke-tab><nuke-tab-panel>Content 1</nuke-tab-panel><nuke-tab-panel>Content 2</nuke-tab-panel></nuke-tabs>. Props reflect as attributes (collapsed, expanded).

items.title: Workspace Structure
items.description: npm workspaces monorepo. Root package.json defines workspaces: ['lib', 'frontend']. Single npm install from root. Frontend depends on @nuke.dev/design-system (symlinked to lib/).

commands.npm install: Install all workspace dependencies from root

details.how_it_works: npm symlinks @nuke.dev/design-system to lib/ folder. Shared deps like @phosphor-icons/webcomponents installed once. Changes to lib available to frontend after rebuild.

structure.frontend/: Svelte 5 docs app - imports lib as dependency

items.title: Primitive Stealing Protocol
items.description: Process for adding new primitives: 1) STEAL behavior from Shoelace (shoelace.style) for web component structure, ARIA, keyboard handling. 2) STEAL CSS patterns from shadcn (ui.shadcn.com) for clean minimal styles. 3) STEAL accessibility from Radix docs (radix-ui.com). 4) BUILD as Lit web component in 3-primitives/. 5) STYLE using Nuke tokens only (--scaling, --radius-*, --space-*, --height-*, layer tokens). Never copy CSS values directly - always map to Nuke tokens.
